draft.subject: Northfield IX is 15.4% of the family's wealth
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

There is one figure I would like the family office to see, because no single statement shows it in this form. Northfield Private Equity Partners IX is 15.4% of your total wealth with us.

That is a large share to rest on one private fund. It sits comfortably with your aim of keeping a strategic alternatives programme, but it also means one manager's results carry a good deal of weight for the whole family.

What I would suggest is that we look at the figure together and you decide whether it is the position you want. If it is, nothing needs to change and I will note the decision on file.

Could we arrange a call this week?
